craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Freed-frees paronomasia kept per UNC (mukto/mocayaty); flash-fast; scores kept. Rejected: (a) splitting paronomasia → killed by UNC. Read aloud: WHO-knows AL-ways … FROM-terr-i-ble BOND-age.

lines: Who knows always — freed, frees others too, beings by the score,
in a flash, from terrible bondage.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti yaḥ satataṃ vetti sa mukto mocayaty | api sattvavrātaṃ kṣaṇenaiva ghorāt saṃsārabandhanāt

reads_against.argmap: Who frees whom? → Knower freed frees scores in a flash.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
